summary: Frontend-only test of iteration-6 features: celebrating fox and confetti on a new footer signup, animated drawings on the compare card backs, and the peach CTA gradient. All 7 requested checks pass on desktop (1920) and on mobile (390, touch context).

issues: The looping green check (top-right) sits next to the check already drawn in fix-form.webp, so two green checks show close together. Cosmetic: consider moving or removing one.
The decorative clouds partly cover the headline and the celebrate area. This is the existing design and not caused by this change. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: IMG_LOOP has an unused 'buried' key; row 7 uses loop 'star'. Harmless dead entry.
Celebrate adds about 150px of height to the success state, so the CTA panel grows when it appears. Expected, but it shifts the layout a little.
seed_data_creation: Created test signups test+<timestamp>@example.com and test+m<timestamp>@example.com (positions #4, #5).

Same email after reload -> 'already on the list — you keep place #N' with 0 fox, 0 confetti, 0 cheer. Invalid 'bad@x' -> footer-signup-error. Desktop hover on cards 0-7: compare-fix-loop-i is present, wrapper gets loop-float/sway/write (animationName loopFloat/loopSway/loopWrite), children run loopPop/loopRise/loopDot/loopDrop/loopTwinkle; mouse leave removes the overlay and the class.
